verdict.rationale: Multi-currency billing is a fair axis for a subscription monetization platform, but nothing in the pack documents per-currency price points, local-currency billing, or reporting converted to a home currency. The charts and Rico items mention metrics and a country-level MRR question, not currency handling, so they do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can bill customers in their local currency with per-currency price points and consolidated reporting in my home currency
